name: Lugaidh, friend of Ailill mac Máta

attributes.attribute: killed Fergus mac Roich with a spear
was the favourite lover of Medb

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lugaidh was an Irish hero and a friend of Ailill mac Mata. He proved deadly to Fergus mac Roich, the warrior who had become the favourite lover of the queen-goddess Medb. That love earned Fergus the anger of Medb's husband Ailill. One day Lugaidh and Ailill came upon the two lovers swimming naked. Ferga, called the warrior-poet, was struck by a spear. Lugaidh was the man who threw that spear.

okr.objective: Document the killing of Fergus mac Roich by Lugaidh, friend of Ailill.
